publications.title: Publications
publications.description: Substack publications to scrape. Use a full URL (https://www.lennysnewsletter.com), a domain (example.substack.com) or just the handle (example).

maxPostsPerPublication.title: Max posts per publication
maxPostsPerPublication.description: Maximum number of posts to return for each publication.

sort.title: Sort posts by
sort.description: Order in which posts are taken from the publication archive.

includeBody.title: Include post body
includeBody.description: Fetch the HTML body of each post. Paid posts return only the part Substack shows publicly. Turning this off makes the run faster.

includeComments.title: Include comments
includeComments.description: Fetch public comments for each post, including the names of the people who wrote them.

maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max comments per post
maxCommentsPerPost.description: Maximum number of comments to return for each post. Used only when comments are included.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy servers to use. Substack usually works without a proxy.
